candidates.change_summary: Replace the keccak256 hash to compute a different function selector, causing the target to behave differently.
Change the return value from constant true to constant false, altering the function's observable result.
Change the require check from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length >= 0, making the guard always true for all array lengths.
Change the low-level call selector from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,uint256).
Change the loop initialization from i=0 to i=1, starting iteration at index 1.
Change caddress to from in the call, calling the from address instead of caddress.
Change the return expression from true to false.
Delete the require statement ensuring _tos is non-empty, allowing empty-array calls to return true instead of reverting.
Change the selector hash input from transferFrom(address,address,uint256) to transfer(address,address,uint256), changing the calldata selector sent to caddress.
Change the loop bound from _tos.length to v.length so the number of external calls depends on the v array length.
Change the loop condition to skip the last iteration by using i < _tos.length - 1, reducing the number of external calls.
Swap the recipient to v[i] and amount to _tos[i] in the external call arguments, changing which address and amount get used.
Change the return value from true to false, directly changing the externally observable return value.
